########################################################################
# Setup library
########################################################################
include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX

list(APPEND bb60c_sources
    bb60c_sweep_impl.cc
)

set(bb60c_sources "${bb60c_sources}" PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT bb60c_sources)
    MESSAGE(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT bb60c_sources)

########################################################################
# Find Signal Hound BB Series API (bb_api)
########################################################################
find_path(BB_API_INCLUDE_DIR
    NAMES bb_api.h
    HINTS /usr/local/include /usr/include
)
find_library(BB_API_LIBRARY
    NAMES bb_api
    HINTS /usr/local/lib /usr/lib
)

if(NOT BB_API_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT BB_API_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "bb_api not found. Install Signal Hound SDK so that bb_api.h and "
        "libbb_api.so are available (e.g. under /usr/local).")
endif()

message(STATUS "Found bb_api include: ${BB_API_INCLUDE_DIR}")
message(STATUS "Found bb_api library: ${BB_API_LIBRARY}")

add_library(gnuradio-bb60c SHARED ${bb60c_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-bb60c
    gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime
    ${BB_API_LIBRARY}
)
target_include_directories(gnuradio-bb60c
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
    PRIVATE ${BB_API_INCLUDE_DIR}
  )
set_target_properties(gnuradio-bb60c PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_bb60c_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-bb60c PROPERTIES
        INSTALL_NAME_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib"
    )
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
GR_LIBRARY_FOO(gnuradio-bb60c)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

########################################################################
# Build and register unit test
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

# If your unit tests require special include paths, add them here
#include_directories()
# List all files that contain Boost.UTF unit tests here
list(APPEND test_bb60c_sources
)
# Anything we need to link to for the unit tests go here
list(APPEND GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-bb60c)

if(NOT test_bb60c_sources)
    MESSAGE(STATUS "No C++ unit tests... skipping")
    return()
endif(NOT test_bb60c_sources)

foreach(qa_file ${test_bb60c_sources})
    GR_ADD_CPP_TEST("bb60c_${qa_file}"
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${qa_file}
    )
endforeach(qa_file)
